title: Conditions of Hire: Changing the Particulars of a Rental
content:
Collection and return times and branches may be changed within the rate class's ceiling on modifications, and the rental is re-priced at the class's rate for the new period. A change carries the class's modification fee, and the difference in rate is collected or returned in addition to it. The main driver may be replaced without charge on every class, provided the replacement meets the class's age range; a replacement outside the range is refused. Adding or removing an additional driver is not a modification and carries only the per-day driver fee for the days the driver is named. Correcting the contact address or contact number is free on every class and never counts toward the modification ceiling. A change requested after the scheduled collection time has passed is not a modification: the renter collects as booked or is recorded as a no-show.

**What counts against the ceiling, and what does not.**

| The change asked for | Counts toward the ceiling | What it costs |
|---|---|---|
| Collection or return time, or branch | yes | The class's modification fee, and the difference in rate collected or returned besides |
| Replacing the main driver | no | Nothing, on every class, where the replacement meets the class's age range |
| Adding or removing an additional driver | no | Only the per-day driver fee for the days that driver is named |
| Correcting the contact address or number | no | Nothing, on every class |

**Re-pricing.** Where the time or the branch moves, the rental on the Car Rental Rate Classes is re-priced at the class's rate for the new period. The difference between the old price and the new is collected from the renter or returned to them, and the class's modification fee stands in addition to that difference rather than in place of it.

**The two refusals.** A replacement main driver whose age falls outside the class's accepted range is refused. And once the scheduled collection time has passed, no change of particulars is a modification at all: the renter collects the vehicle as booked, or the rental is recorded as a no-show.
